# SARL SITTELLE

> Explore custom packaging, cardboard packaging and offset printing from SARL SITTELLE.

Based in Boufarik, SARL SITTELLE is a printing company specialising in packaging, cardboard packaging and offset printing.
Our work brings together custom packaging and printed materials, including posters, leaflets, flyers and point-of-sale advertising.

## Services
- Custom packaging: Cardboard packaging shaped around your product, its dimensions and your visual identity.
- Offset printing: Posters, leaflets, flyers and point-of-sale materials that give your message a physical form.
- Branded print materials: Printed materials that carry your visual identity into your everyday communication.
